methods.label: Find the constant and substitute
methods.explanation:
First use the known pair \(S=8\), \(R=16\) to determine the constant \(g\). Substitution into \(R=gS-4\) gives
\[
16=8g-4,
\qquad 20=8g,
\qquad g=\frac52.
\]
Now the same formula determines \(R\) when \(S=10\):
\[
R=\frac52\cdot 10-4=25-4=21.
\]
Thus \(\boxed{21}\) is choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
